name: stripe-sync
description: Run your Stripe payment links from your offer docs, without the dashboard: create a tagged link, check amounts against the docs, and close an offer's links when it ends.

stripe_api_key.title: Stripe secret key
stripe_api_key.description: Your Stripe secret key. Use a test key (sk_test_...) to try it safely in Stripe's sandbox. The plugin reads it as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_STRIPE_API_KEY; if your setup does not pass it through, export STRIPE_API_KEY in your shell instead.
